entities.name: Ram Vanji Sutar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ram Vanji Sutar was an Indian sculptor. He designed the Statue of Unity which is the world's tallest statue with a height of 182 metres, exceeding the Spring Temple Buddha by 54 metres.
